about.label: About
about.title: About
about.subtitle: A short essay about who I am and what I am building.
about.narrative:
I was born in Aleppo. I grew up watching a city change. Today I am in Ankara, in my final year of AI Engineering at OSTİM Technical University.

I build practical AI — tools that work for real people, not just research papers.

What I am building now is for Syria. A country that needs builders more than anything else.
about.nowText: Building NeuralCheck. First launch in Azaz, August 2026.
about.toolsLine: Python · Kotlin · TypeScript · Firebase · Claude API · and a notebook.
about.philosophyQuote: I'd rather ship a small thing that helps real people than a big thing nobody uses.
about.philosophyBody: Deployment teaches what theory cannot. I try to write code a teammate can read at 2 a.m. without cursing me.
